title: Onboard cygnus-3b v1.0 - performance profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Add cygnus-3b v1.0 to the model registry with complete metadata, calibrated performance profiles for common serving configurations, and automated changelog/release-note entries. This PR bundles: 1) model metadata (model_card, config, tokenizer compatibility, recommended quantization profiles, inference knobs), 2) performance profiles for CPU/GPU/quantized variants covering typical sequence lengths and batch sizes, and 3) an update to the changelog generator so that new model onboarding events produce a curated release note entry and link to the model card. Checklist: - [x] Generate model metadata JSON and model card summary - [x] Produce perf profiles for A100-40GB, T4, and CPU baseline - [x] Add test vectors and smoke evals for stability/regression - [x] Wire onboarding event into changelog automation pipeline - [x] Update docs snippet and quickstart to reference cygnus-3b - [x] Add Linear links and test CI perf checks Summary of changes: added cygnus-3b v1.0 metadata under metadata/cygnus-3b/v1.0/, performance profiles under perf-profiles/cygnus-3b/v1.0/, small updates to changelog-generator to support model:onboard events, and unit + integration tests for the new assets. Reasoning: cygnus-3b was validated by research for quality on our eval suite and provides a good mid-size option for customers wanting lower-cost throughput. The perf profiles are important to provide accurate cost/latency estimates in the Console and to allow automatic routing to quantized variants. Rollout plan: merged to main; CD job publishes metadata to the registry and notifies the model-catalog webhook; Console picks up new model during nightly sync. If any regressions are observed the model can be rolled back by removing the v1.0 metadata entry and bumping the catalog pointer. Notes on changelog automation: new onboarding events create a draft release-note entry in changelog/drafts/ with a templated summary and links to model_card and perf profiles; a follow-up job composes the public release note during the next release. Testing: unit tests added for metadata validator, perf profile schema, changelog templater; integration test added to verify Console sync sees the new model. CI passes including perf smoke which compares latency to the expected profile within 10%.

perf_profiles_summary: A100-40GB baseline: 28ms median for seq=128, batch=1; T4 baseline: 72ms median seq=128 batch=1; CPU baseline: 420ms median seq=128 batch=1. Quantized int8 (A100): 22ms median seq=128 batch=1 with measured 6% quality delta on eval suite; quantized 4-bit profile available for T4 with ~14% latency improvement versus fp16. Profiles include throughput curves for batch sizes 1/4/8 and tail-latency (p95/p99). All profiles include upstream kernel hints and recommended batcher window settings for Console auto-suggestions.
metadata_summary: Model card includes architecture, tokenizer, training data provenance (redacted), recommended input preprocessing, safety notes, default sampling params, and compatibility matrix (redwood runtime versions and tokenizer binaries). Manifest contains model size, shard count, supported formats (ggml, fp16, triton), quantization knobs, and recommended environment labels.
automation_details: Changelog generator: on model:onboard events the handler creates a draft entry under changelog/drafts/ with fields (title, summary, links, release_category=model). The templater supports insertion of perf-profile snippets and a short guidance note for customers. A scheduled job composes published notes from drafts during release windows. The handler is idempotent and uses manifest checksum to avoid duplicate drafts.
release_notes: - Added cygnus-3b v1.0 to the model catalog with performance profiles and model card. - Changelog automation: onboarding events now generate draft release-note entries with perf snippets. - Console: quickstart example and docs updated to reference cygnus-3b.
